title: Founder Persistence Operator Controls
goal: Make approved local founder workflow persistence operator-usable while preserving the NEXUS safety boundary.
globalSafetyRules: Implement one subphase at a time.
Do not modify projects/**, careloop/**, generated app Sources/Tests, providers/**, tools/**, worker-runtime/**, deploy/**, release/**, exports/**, packages/**, or .env*.
P95.1 is contract-only and must not modify db/**, dashboard source, live runtime models, or local-state runtime data.
Later P95 subphases may only operate on allowlisted NEXUS OS founder workflow records where explicitly scoped.

Do not enable provider/model calls, agent dispatch, tool execution, worker execution, project creation, project mutation, hosted DB mutation, network calls, deploy, release, export, package creation, or provider spend.
Do not expose DemoApp in full Command Center.
Do not show project/private raw IDs in primary UX.
Do not invent fake working actions.
reuseRequirements: Reuse shared/redaction.js where display-safe text requires redaction.
Reuse os-roadmap/updatePhaseStatus.js if phase stamping needs a helper.
Reuse live-ready/founderRuntimeDbCrudWorkflow.js instead of duplicating founder DB CRUD admission.
Reuse db/sqliteCrudRepository.js instead of adding another CRUD repository.
Reuse existing Command Center tabs/cards/badges and route matrix.

subphases.objective: Define the founder persistence operator controls contract before runtime, DB, or UX changes.

expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.futureDataShape: Result envelope with schemaVersion, currentState, runtimeMode, dbMode, approvalState, approvalEvidence, localEntitySummaries[], pendingControlActions[], allowedLocalCrudOperations[], forbiddenOperations[], rollbackPlan, auditRefs[], evidenceRefs[], activityRefs[], nextAction, blockers[], disabledReason, ownerCapability, costImpact, commandCenterVisible, and all non-scoped unsafe runtime flags false.

subphases.commandCenterUxRequirements: Preserve current Command Center UX in P95.1. Later P95 UX must show saved founder workflow state, explicit local persistence approval state, local read/write posture, rollback/audit evidence, next action, blockers, disabled reason, owner capability, evidence/activity location, and cost impact without raw JSON, raw logs, raw policy dumps, DemoApp, raw private IDs, or fake runnable actions.
playwrightTests: No Playwright update in P95.1 because no UI files change.
P95 Command Center UX subphase must add focused Lite, Business Build, and DB Runtime route coverage.
testsCheckers: Preserve route-wide safety tests in later UX subphases.
finalSafetyChecks: Confirm no db/**, dashboard/src/**, dashboard/tests/**, live-ready/**, or local-state/runtime/** files changed.
Confirm no provider/model calls, agent dispatch, tool/worker execution, project creation, project mutation, hosted DB mutation, network, deploy, release, export, package, or spend is enabled.
gitCommands: git commit -m "feat(nexus): define founder persistence controls contract"
finalResponseChecklist: Docs, roadmap, and OS phase status updates
